in_hindi.name: ब्रजमोहन

in_marathi.name: Brajamohan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Braja
in_marathi.long_meaning: Brajamohan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Brajamohan is a Sanskrit name that translates to 'Lord of Braja'. It is derived from the words 'Braj' meaning 'Braja', which is a region in India, and 'Mohan' meaning 'enchanter' or 'attractor'. This name is used to refer to Lord Krishna, who is believed to be the ruler of Braja and the one who attracts and enchants everyone.
